decisions.statement: A localhost origin is refused rather than driven.
The shot is taken once the render has settled rather than on the first paint.
A settle that ran out is shot as the page is rather than refused.
A run opens the browser as nobody unless `--signed-in` says otherwise.
`--signed-in` shoots the page as the contributor Alan's person page names.
`--full-page` shoots the whole scrolling page rather than what the window holds.
The window is 1440 wide and 1000 tall where the call says neither.
The folder the file sits in is made where that folder is not there already.
The answer is the path written and nothing more.
The browser is closed whether the shot was taken or thrown.
Nothing here judges what the shot shows.

definition: the command writing a PNG of one page on a deployed site
